sub_palette: germanic (norse) backbone + mesoamerican (nahuatl) overlay (cross-family blend, Germanic-leaning)

blend.backbone: germanic (norse register: konungr/jarl, nominative -r, -son/-dottir, retained th/dh, ei/ey diphthongs, root-initial stress, dithematic names)
blend.overlay: mesoamerican (nahuatl: the altepetl pyramid-cities, the teocalli temple-priesthood, the calpolli wards, the -tl/-tli absolutive and -tzin reverential, -tlan/-tepec/-co place-suffixes, the feathered-serpent kingship)
blend.lean: Germanic-heavy - a Norse sky-warrior aristocracy enthroned over a Nahua temple-civilization: the longship-warriors rule from the sun-pyramids, the feathered-serpent cities and their priesthood and populace endure and serve beneath.

_note: NEW cross-family hybrid under the base/hybrid model. BASE_01 Thiodmark (Germanic) x BASE_10 (Mesoamerican/Nahua). REPURPOSES and supersedes the old culture_huitzilan kit (catalog 28), which was authored as a narrow Chaotic-only blood-cult clanhold; Tollangard reuses huitzilan's Norse+Nahuatl linguistic material - the fused lexicon, the fused titles, the Agrippan deity-morphs and the name-stock - but BROADENS it into the general Germanic-leaning Mesoamerican hybrid for the new model. The huitzilan file is LEFT INTACT pending a Claude Code retirement pass. CIV/CLAN DECIDED by inheritance: Germanic base = Clanhold, Mesoamerican base = Civilized, and any Civ parent -> Civ, so Tollangard is Civilized (feudal). Concept: northern sky-warriors who conquered the pyramid-cities of the southern highlands and set up as kings over the temple-civilization - the Norse war-host rules, the Nahua altepetl endures (a Norse-Aztec fusion; 'Tollan's-enclosure'). Backbone = Germanic (norse: the ruling war-aristocracy, the konungr/jarl register, dithematic and -son names); overlay/substrate = Nahuatl (the altepetl-cities, the teocalli temples, the calpolli wards, the populace and the priesthood). Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Old Norse and Nahuatl registers (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon from both parents (Norse reflexes primary, Nahuatl variants secondary), never real Norse/Aztec gods. PROVISIONAL: alignment broadened from huitzilan's Chaotic-ONLY to Chaotic/Neutral - the blood-cult heritage (the offered heart, the berserker's frenzy) remains AVAILABLE as the Chaotic streak, but is no longer the only stance; pending the alignment pass. [UPDATE 2026-06-27: all human cultures allow Lawful/Neutral/Chaotic (per-hybrid alignment restriction removed). Ruler/domain DISPLAY titles are now English (or an approved foreign term); conlang titles moved to ruler_native/domain_native for NPC dialogue. Deities unchanged: canonical Agrippan pantheon via the per-family morph method.]

phonology.palette: Germanic (Norse) backbone - root-initial stress, sharp stops p/t/k b/d/g, the dental fricatives th/dh, the nominative -r, ei/ey diphthongs, dithematic compounding - meeting a Nahuatl overlay: the absolutive -tl/-tli and reverential -tzin, the affricate tz, x (sh), hu/w, ku, and a penultimate-pull stress. Per the CSV: glottal stops mixed with sharp stops; grammar is SVO with possessive-case inflections carried on Norse strong stems and Nahuatl absolutives. The Norse nominative -r and the Nahuatl absolutive -tl collide into fused endings -atl/-tr/-r. Theophoric on the Norse reflexes (Thulr-, Orlund-) with Nahuatl variants (Tolratl-, Orlantzin-).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC and the clusters tl/tz/kn/fj/ku meeting Norse st/sk/br; fused -atl/-tr/-r endings; glottal stops; root-initial Norse stress with a Nahuatl penultimate pull; dithematic Norse names over -tlan/-tepec/-gard toponyms.

sound_changes: Nahuatl absolutive -tl/-tli and the glottal stop adapt to Norse endings: -tl/-tli>-r/-tr/-l, glottal-stop>0; saltillo never closes a syllable
Norse nominative -r and root-initial stress imposed on every word; Norse clusters (st, sk, br, kn, fj) permitted; the Nahuatl penultimate pull survives only as secondary stress
Nahuatl long and reduplicated 'vibrant' vowels clipped to a single Norse vowel; hu-/w- > Norse v-/w-, ku- kept
retain Norse th/dh, ei/ey and the Nahuatl signatures tz, x (sh) and the -tl onset; very short roots take a Norse -r ending
fusion_rules.source_tilt: land/terrain/pyramid/material/staple words from Nahuatl roots (the substrate works the land and raises the teocalli: atl>at-, tepetl>tep-, teotl>teo-, centli>cen-); kin-line/quality/abstract/rule/war words from Norse roots (the ruling war-register: huey-/konr/jarl/yao-); every root then filtered to the one Norse-shaped phonology

lexicon._note: Single fused tongue derived via phonology.fusion_rules (gdd-hybrid-conlang-fusion.md): Nahuatl land/pyramid/material/staple roots + Norse rule/kin/quality/war roots, all run through one Norse-shaped sound-law (the -tl/glottal adapted to Norse -r/clusters, vibrant vowels clipped); portmanteaus mark the blended institutions and bloodline. One word per concept, no slashes.

morphology.patronymic_form: the Norse ruling house keeps a dithematic lineage-name and the -son/-dottir patronymic; the Nahua populace keep the calpolli (ward) and the calendar-day name; the throne fuses both - a konungr who also carries a calpolli-house style. Renowned warriors take an earned deed-name.
morphology.compounding_rule: Norse dithematic ([quality|animal](stem) + element: Tlil-tepfjall black-mountain, Chich-atoyr red-river) layered over Nahuatl place-compounds (-tlan/-tepec/-co): the capital Tollangard (Tollan's-enclosure), Quetz-altepr (the feathered city), the calpolli-wards named for their power or peak; -gard/-borg for the steadings.

title_ladder.government: feudal (a Norse war-aristocracy over the Nahua temple-cities: the konungr and his jarl-kin at the crown, the tecuhtli-governors over the altepetl-cities, the karl-retainers sworn to the war-host; the teopixqui-priesthood and the calpolli wards serve beneath)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Fused Norse-Nahuatl ladder, ascending; the titles blend the two (Norse jarl/konungr + Nahua tecuhtli/tlatoani). Hertekw (war-lord; *harja-tugon) barony; Yaomark (border war-chief) march; Tecujarl (lord; tecuhtli + jarl) county over a Jarlatl; Tlacafylk (war-leader; tlaca- + fylki) duchy; Kontlatl (city-king; konungr + tlatoani) principality; Hueykonr (great king; huey- + konungr) kingdom over a Hueykonatl; Cemkonr (the all-king; cem-anahuac + konungr) empire over Cem-Tollangard. The conquered cities keep their Nahua tecuhtli (city-lord) and teopixqui (priest) beneath the Norse crown. (Rank titles fuse the real Norse/Nahuatl register, allowed.)
title_ladder.display_policy: Ruler/domain titles shown in setting-gen, domain lists and vassal trees are ENGLISH (or an approved commonly-known foreign term where set in 'ruler'). The *_native conlang forms are for NPC DIALOGUE ONLY, never for structural/UI displays.

people_name_convention.order: the Norse ruling stock carry a dithematic name + -son/-dottir patronymic and a lineage; the Nahua populace carry a calendar-day name + calpolli (ward); renowned warriors take an earned deed-name; order given-first.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the Norse war-aristocracy keep dithematic and -son names (Itz-, Yao-, -ketill, -grimr, -bjorn); the Nahua city-folk keep day-names and theophoric constructs (X-coatl, Quetz-, Xochi-) on the morphed canon-stems.
people_name_convention.theophoric: Norse devotional on the Norse god-reflexes (Thulr-, Orlund-); Nahua devotional constructs on the Nahua variants: Tolratl-coatl (of Tolratl), Marakatl- (of the war-fire). Older Chaotic-streak names invoke the blood powers: Eztli- (blood), Yao- (war), -tletl (fire).

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon - Norse Germanic reflexes PRIMARY (family_germanic theonym_ancestors, the norse column), Nahuatl variants SECONDARY (family_mesoamerican theonym_sets, the nahuatl column), never real Norse/Aztec gods. ALIGNMENT IS PROVISIONAL (Chaotic/Neutral), broadened from huitzilan's Chaotic-only: the blood-cult heritage survives as the Chaotic streak (the offered heart atop the teocalli, the berserker's frenzy of the war-host), but Neutral worship - the ancestral war-dead and the city-powers invoked situationally - is now also available. Pending the alignment pass.
religion.the_one: Eitnir (Norse; Nahua Aiternatl) - the distant Ancient One, the cold sky above the lesser powers; honored or reviled by alignment

Tulrius.gloss: the sun and justice, the sky-fire of the conquerors

Maraxus.gloss: the War-Fire, the Blood-Sun of the cult

worship_by_alignment.Lawful: Venerates the Lawful powers of the canon - Eitnir foremost - and names the Chaotic powers as demons to be warded.
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: the ancestral war-dead of the ruling house (the deydr) and the city-powers of the altepetl and the calpolli-ward, the powers of peak, hearth and pyramid invoked situationally rather than worshipped wholesale; the great gods petitioned at the teoharg and the burial-howe as need demands
worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: the blood-cult heritage - venerates the Chaotic powers, chief among them Marhr the War-Fire and Blood-Sun that must be fed, and the feathered hoard-serpent Lusankoatl; the One (Eitnir) and the Lawful powers are reviled as the cold sky-tyrants; the berserker's frenzy and the offered heart are one rite, the teoharg (blood-temple) atop the tepfjall and the skull-rack the altars

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: under Neutral or against the Chaotic streak, the warded powers keep their morphs + an epithet: under Chaotic worship the One and the Lawful powers are the enemy-gods (Eitnir the Tyrant-Sun, Thulr the Cold-Sun, Orlund the Soft-Oath); under Neutral the Chaotic powers are warded - Maraxus -> Marhr the War-Brand (Nahua Marakatl the City-Burner); Vacidus -> Vakr the Unmaker (Nahua Wakitl); Lusanto -> Lusandr the Hoard-Worm.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Teoharg (temple) atop the tepfjall (peak) of [power], the Nahua substrate keeping the teocalli (pyramid-temple): 'the Teoharg of Marhr', 'the Teocalli of Tolratl'.
religion.saints_pattern: fallen kings and the greatest reavers become sun-feeding storm-riders; the deydr (ancestral war-dead) honored at the skull-rack, the burial-howe and the pyramid-tomb.
